paras: Maintain your BMW's front brake monitoring system with this Dixcel brake wear sensor, engineered in Japan and designed as a direct OEM replacement. Brake wear sensors are a critical safety component that alerts you when your brake pads have reached their minimum thickness, ensuring timely pad replacement and consistent braking performance.

This listing covers the Dixcel front brake wear sensor for a wide range of BMW platforms including the 1 Series (F20) , 2 Series (F22/F23/G42) , 3 Series (F30/F31/F34/G20/G21) , 4 Series (F32/F33/F36/G22/G23/G26) , i4 (G26) , M135i/M140i (F20) , M2/M2 Competition/M2 CS (F87/G87) , M235i/M240i (F22/F23) , M3/M3 Competition (F80/G80/G81) , and M4/M4 Competition/M4 CSL (F82/G82/G83) . This sensor is a single-use component and should be replaced each time new brake pads are fitted.
ft: DIXCEL Front Brake Wear Sensor for BMW M2 (F87/G87) / M3 (G80) / M4 (G82) / 3 Series (G20)
